newsitem.title: USA: Molten Metal sees disappointing Q1, Q2.
newsitem.headline: Molten Metal sees disappointing Q1, Q2.

text.p: Molten Metal Technology Inc said Thursday its full-year 1996 and 1997 first and second quarter results would likely fall below analysts' estimates,
Molten Metal said it would seek an extension for filing 1996 results and might have to restate previous quarterly figures.
The company did not specify analysts' expectations for results for 1996 and the 1997 first and second quarters, and First Call analysts' estimates were not listed for the firm.

Molten Metal said 1996 results would be hurt primarily due to potential reassessment of the value of certain fixed assets, and disputes pertaining to receivables totalling $4.965 million from its M4 limited partnership with Lockheed Martin Corp .
It said certain charges related to organizational changes at M4 will impact Molten Metal's first and second quarters, which it now expects to be below analysts' expectations.
